title: John's Warm-Up
about: A memory of John leading the group through the familiar stomp-and-clap rhythm warm-up.
description: This track remembers John leading one of the group's warm-ups, building the rhythm from feet to knees, hips, hands, and finally the head. The familiar stomp-and-clap pattern pulled everyone into the same beat, ending with the playful "bing bong" head movement. The warm-up itself wasn't unique to him, but his presence leading it became part of the memory.

Lyrics: John stood up and called us in,
Boots hit the floor, then hands came down,
Stomp and clap filled up the room with sound.
Hips and hands followed the rest.
Everybody moving to the same heartbeat.
Whole room falling into the groove.
From our feet all the way to our head,
Then our heads tipped side to side—
And John leading all of us
